blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Here is a gentleman whom by chance I met, Upon agreement from us to his liking, Will undertake to woo curst Katharine.
exercises.ru: Вот джентльмен, ___ я случайно встретил и который согласился ухаживать за отвратительной Катариной.
exercises.why: «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI, Lesson 53. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
